parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end. <short pause> Jeremiah, chapter twenty-nine, verse eleven.

Lord, You know every thought about my future, and Your heart toward me is peace, not harm. <short pause> You have a purpose and a hope prepared for me. <short pause> As I sleep, I let go of my worries and trust Your good plans. <short pause> Amen.
